title: I enter the Holy of Holies
lyrics_original: I enter the Holy of Holies
I enter through the blood of the Lamb
I enter to worship You only
I enter to honor I am
Lord I worship You, I worship You,
Lord I worship You, I worship You,
For Your name is Holy, Holy Lord
For Your name is Holy, Holy Lord
Let the weight of Your glory cover us
Let the life of Your river flow
Let the truth of Your kingdom reign in us
Let the weight of Your glory
Let the weight of Your glory fall

bible_verses.telugu: సహోదరులారా, యేసు మనకొరకు ప్రతిష్ఠించిన మార్గమున, అనగా నూతనమైనదియు, జీవముగలదియు, ఆయన శరీరము అను తెరద్వారా యేర్పరచబడినదియునైన మార్గమున,
bible_verses.english: Therefore, brothers and sisters, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకు దేవుడునేను ఉన్నవాడను అను వాడనైయున్నానని మోషేతో చెప్పెను. మరియు ఆయనఉండుననువాడు మీయొద్దకు నన్ను పంపెనని నీవు ఇశ్రాయేలీయులతో చెప్పవలెననెను.
bible_verses.english: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”

bible_verses.telugu: వారుసైన్యముల కధిపతియగు యెహోవా, పరిశుద్ధుడు పరిశుద్ధుడు పరిశుద్ధుడు; సర్వలోకము ఆయన మహిమతో నిండియున్నది అని గొప్ప స్వరముతో గాన ప్రతిగానములు చేయుచుండిరి.
bible_verses.english: And they were calling to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord Almighty; the whole earth is full of his glory.”

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, I thank You that Jesus opened the way for me to enter Your sacred presence today. I bow before Your holy name, overwhelmed by Your majesty and grace. Cover me with the weight of Your glorious presence and let Your living waters refresh my heart. I fix my eyes solely on You, Jesus, giving You all my praise, honor, and love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord God, I thank You that Jesus opened the way for me to enter Your sacred presence today. I bow before Your holy name, overwhelmed by Your majesty and grace. Cover me with the weight of Your glorious presence and let Your living waters refresh my heart. I fix my eyes solely on You, Jesus, giving You all my praise, honor, and love. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Through the precious blood of Jesus, the veil has been torn, opening the way for us to step directly into God's holy presence with confidence. We are no longer distant observers, but beloved children welcomed into the Holy of Holies to behold the majesty of the Great "I AM." As we sing, we surrender our distractions and allow the holy weight of His glory to rest upon us, refreshing our souls like a living river. Today, fix your heart on His holiness and let His love draw you deeper into intimate worship.
